verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only single-message operations (draft, update, delete), query and filter parameters, and Inbox rules that act on incoming messages. None of it shows a batch or bulk endpoint, or any way to act on many existing items at once. Per-item CRUD combined with queries is a developer building block, and Inbox rules are an adjacent automation feature for new mail, so neither earns credit for bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
